steps: Opened title, saw globe, pressed the big Take office as Saudi Arabia button
Hit a mission wall of text on a dark overlay, pressed Take office
Desk screen: picked the staff-picked Back channel card, pressed Execute month
Saw the What happened page with a Yemen reaction and meters moving
Month 2: pressed Approve 4 suggestions then Execute month, the tab froze
scenarios.notes: First satisfying reaction came at roughly 2 minutes, then the second Execute froze the page.

steps: Chose the peace-minded Back channel via Muscat crisis response
scenarios.notes: Never got to see peace happen: Yemen's view of me went from -100 to -90 only; then the tab froze.

friction.happened: Full paragraph of text, the sentence 'You are the Crown Prince and Prime Minister' appears twice (italic and mission box)
Three panes, 6 sidebar groups, meetings, capital dots, orders, a tip banner; looks like work software

friction.expected: Clear which button advances the month
friction.happened: Two buttons, Approve 4 suggestions and Execute month, unclear if Execute alone is enough

friction.expected: Tapping the Diplomacy tab goes to page 2
friction.happened: Tab did not respond to my click on the first try; only the bottom button worked

friction.expected: Result of my Sanctions on Iran vote
friction.happened: Approve then Execute month made the page freeze for good

bugs.title: Page freezes completely after Execute month on month 2
bugs.actual: Tab unresponsive for 2+ minutes; screenshots, goto and reload all time out; no page errors logged

bugs.title: Debrief tab 'Diplomacy' ignored a click
steps: After Execute, click the Diplomacy tab at the top
bugs.actual: Stayed on page 1 (the label matcher may have hit another element)

bugs.title: Mission intro repeats the same sentence twice
bugs.actual: 'You are the Crown Prince and Prime Minister' in italic intro and in mission card

suggestions.what: Cut the mission intro to one line and one Go button; show the goal as an icon strip
suggestions.goal_served: Have fun within two minutes, no wall of text

suggestions.what: On first month show one highlighted card and one big Do it button; hide meetings, capital dots and the sidebar until needed
Make the result of a choice bigger and quicker, with the world map reacting, before any numbers
suggestions.goal_served: See something satisfying happen because of a choice

delight: Title globe with a pulsing pin and 'Pick a fire' looked like a real game
The Back channel result page with a character quote and a green bar going up (004-exec1.png)
The newspaper front page in the chronicle (008-deb-p4.png)

fun.reason: One nice payoff, then nothing more because the game froze.

clarity.reason: Cards were readable but the desk had too many panes, buttons and tiny grey labels.

visual.reason: Title globe, illustrated crisis cards and newspaper look crafted.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Title and result look like a game, the desk looks like work software.

agency.reason: I could pick, but the staff pre-filled everything and the final freeze left me stuck with no explanation.

realism.reason: Real leader names and headlines felt believable; I did not dig.

replay.reason: I would not reopen a game that hung.

recommend.reason: Pretty, but it froze in month 2 and the desk screen is too heavy for a friend who just wants a quick game.

quit_point: Month 2: pressed Execute month after Approve 4 suggestions and the tab froze (about 5 minutes in); before that, the mission text wall and dense desk had already used up my first confusion.
verbatim: It looked great on the first screen and then I got a desk full of tiny labels, and when I pressed the big orange button the second time it just froze. Closed.
